principle: A candidate model is not colony-bindable until a real runtime receipt exists on an approved compute class.

failure_classes.INFRA_BUG: does not count against model quality
failure_classes.RESOURCE_FAILURE: records incompatibility with that compute class only
failure_classes.MODEL_LOAD_FAILURE: candidate unavailable on tested runtime until repaired
failure_classes.QUALITY_FAILURE: runtime works but cold benchmark fails

resource_policy.oom: record RESOURCE_FAILURE; do not hide or silently substitute another model

current.claim_scope: runtime load + inference only; no quality winner
